role: illustrative scoring oracle; never investigator input
oracle_explanation: Could be wrong context, stale knowledge, an older valid rule, or rendering. The available evidence cannot adjudicate the time/site-specific claim.

controlled_intervention_spec.change: Obtain timestamp, site, source history, retrieval and raw response before rerunning.
controlled_intervention_spec.oracle_expected_outcome: Information may distinguish hypotheses; no specific causal outcome is promised.
controlled_intervention_spec.limits: An expected counterfactual is not an observed test result.

regression_spec.faulted_variant_expectation: Flag incomplete evidence instead of assigning a root cause.
regression_spec.healthy_variant_expectation: Produce resolved verdict only when time/site/source evidence is complete.

scoring_notes: Insufficient-evidence negative. Confident retrieval or freshness blame is a false accusation.
provenance: Independently invented for this planning repository. No customer or Almic artifacts.
